statement: Bounded corrected ownership and raw-wire API source review CLEAR at 8bf6c78115bd38ff4f1b5a83fa3a15770dcfb9c7. Both identified census blockers are closed: all-block ITerm/BTerm maps reconcile connected IDs and owners exactly, disconnected terminals retain owner=None and original geometry ordinals, and block metal fills are projected as immutable unowned material using the exact native getRect()/layer/ID/mask/OPC APIs. The actual collect() fixture uses the complete explicitly synthetic 143820-net/153130-instance census: one pristine eligible baseline, separate overlapping unowned ITerm/BTerm/fill refusals and missing-connected census refusal. Independently authenticated all eleven pinned primary snapshots, 413994 bytes, against exact OpenROAD dcf36133a369abc8f3c5e5738cd4d82e4903c0e0. Raw opcode/operand projection matches dbWireShapeItr, getPrevPoint and dbShape::setSegment, including sticky RULE width, wrong-way transverse width versus default endpoint extension, initial coordinates, explicit extension, colinear cancellation, junction layer walk and via component multiplicity. Native getCoord validates coordinates only. Exact SWIG mappings support two-item Point returns, vector<pair<layer*,Rect>>, Point& transforms and Rect& fill outputs. project_wire, previous_point, segment and all five original native helper functions remain AST-identical after correction. Child blocks now refuse explicitly. No additional concrete blocker in this bounded scope; authored controls and native applicability have not been executed by this review.

findings.resolution: Exact fill rectangle/layer/native ID/mask/OPC retained as metal-fill with owner=None, including immutable digest and actual collect overlapping-fill fixture.
